external_control.source: Golovach-Paulusma-Song, Closing complexity gaps for coloring problems on H-free graphs
external_control.result: List 4-Coloring is NP-complete on P6-free graphs via Positive/Not-All-Equal 3-SAT.
hard_family_JI: one variable vertex x_i per variable, list {1,2}
two P5 clause gadgets a-b-a-b-a per clause
a-type lists in first copy {2,4},{2,3,4},{2,3}; second copy {1,4},{1,3,4},{1,3}
every variable is adjacent to every b-type vertex
each clause occurrence x_{i_h} is adjacent to the corresponding a_{j,h} and a'_{j,h}
external_control.control_interpretation: Taking all a-type vertices as the stable selector side gives a known NP-hard P6-free mixed 2/3-list family with no 4-list selector.

local_expressiveness_control.statement: For any nonempty M subseteq [4], a singleton residual component C={z} with base list B_C(z)=M has mu_C(F)=1 iff M is not a subset of F, hence MIN_BAD(C)={M}.
local_expressiveness_control.consequence: MIN_BAD/stable-selector syntax alone does not restrict individual selector lists.
